build: TypeScript source via tsx; same node_modules link for each detached worktree
ordering: Alternating historical/current processes; accepted runs selected by CPU monitoring, with retries for typecheck overlap
quietCriteria: No test runners/workers or CPU-bound browser renderers; sampling every 0.5 or 1 second throughout accepted runs, excluding any with a tsc or Chrome process over 50% CPU. Usual desktop and esbuild activity remained. Load average was falling from prior activity; it was not used as an idle criterion.
exclusions: Initial boundary-only runs are not used. Monitored checkpoint runs 2, 3, 6, after2 attempt1, and nov1b attempt1 excluded for typecheck overlap. RSK timing also excluded for a typechecker overlap; its deterministic work counts remain valid.
retainedMemory: Three GC samples per process, each yielding to another event-loop job. Holding retains 200 unconsumed results. Released follows validation of every result and release, and includes engine caches populated during validation. This is not a leak test.
